description: Run one Google search and get the first page of organic results as JSON: title, URL, description and position, plus related queries. Use it when: You need a ranked list of web pages for a query, to pick sources or check what ranks. Not for: Reading the pages themselves; the Web search to Markdown node returns their full text. Returns: The first page of Google results: position, title, URL and description, plus related queries and People also ask. Typical time: about 8 s. Price: $0.008 per search, charged only on success. One call = one page of Google results.

countryCode.description: Optional two-letter country code, lowercase, e.g. us, gb, de
